listing.name: QoL weaponAmounts - Sell your excess stuff. Automatically.
listing.displayName: QoL weaponAmounts - Sell your excess stuff. Automatically
listing.summary: Automatically sells excess weapons and LPCs from cargo and colony stockpiles when entering a market.
listing.aiSummary: Automatically sells excess weapons and LPCs from cargo and colony stockpiles when entering a market.

description:
[start promotional pitch]

Ever end up with absurd stockpiles of weapons and LPCs on your colonies? Never quite know if those 820 weapons you're lugging around after a few battles are worth bringing home, and too lazy to check the owned tooltip on each one?

Well here's the solution.

weaponAmounts

Maybe. Unless I screwed up :P

Never wrote a mod for anything before but this thing has been bugging me forever. Couldn't find a mod that did it so I thought wth, I can give it a shot. So far it seems to work decently for me in my own game, but I'd love feedback and someone to test it out to see if it works like it is supposed to elsewhere, and if I screwed up something.

In short, it's a simple mod that just counts the weapons and LPCs you own (cargo+colony stockpiles) and whenever you enter a station or planet with a market matching the one you want to sell at, i.e open or black, it automatically sells any cargo you have that exceeds a set threshold value (default 25).

Does not count mounted weapons/LPCs, but I could do that too I think. If you like keeping well-outfitted ships around I don't see the real gain though, as it's mostly for hoarders like me in the late game.

Includes an optional config file for those who don't run LunaLib (weaponAmountsSettings.json in data/config), so it doesn't really depend on LunaLib. However if you have it, which is absolutely recommended, it ignores that file and uses the in-game mod menu (F3 I think) to allow you to enable/disable, choose market and set the threshold while in game.

Download weaponAmounts.7z

Shouldn't interfere with anything else, doesn't really require LunaLib, and should be safe to remove. To get started, configure the mod, load up all your colony junk at your colony (hopefully one with a market) and just leave/reenter and drop your new and slimmed down stash back. From then as long as the mod is enabled, will auto-sell anything you loot at any market you visit depending on your mod settings and colony/cargo stash.

Have fun.
